question: Closest prior art for global-context regional Hecate inference

sources.finding: Existing surface-model --bbox fix keeps the parent volume patch grid, so ROI and full runs agree. This is direct prior art for the principle, explicitly credited.

Current runtime verified identical to local reviewed pinned code; predict accepts full volume/output and has no regional output arguments. Features, uint8 export and dual-pass 2D/3D behavior are upstream.
Paired 2D/3D feature reuse already proposed by another contributor. Excluded from our novelty claim.
Existing faster 2D pipeline and stride/accuracy measurements. Inspected code has no regional API or 3D output path.
Progress Prize next deadline 31 October2026 23:59Pacific. Requires demonstrated significant advantage; private submission permitted, permissive public release required to accept award.
Newer scans cite Angelotti et al., Vesuvius Challenge - CT Scans of Herculaneum Papyri. Data portal states CC BY-NC4.0 unless a specific asset says otherwise.

novelty_scope: A concrete Hecate implementation and validation of an established global-grid technique, not invention of ROI inference. No proof of field-wide novelty or organizer acceptance.
